scope: Active B, C, C*, D after saved user removals, level changes and transfers; mappings do not infer coverage from another level.
method: Legal replay of actual discoveries throughout each saved line. Preparatory king moves do not count as King clearance. Promotion in a solution is distinguished from promotion that itself uncovers an attack. Geometric tags do not by themselves justify retaining near-duplicates.
